study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Ma et al., Journal of Behavioral Addictions, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Comparative analysis of cortical anatomy in male participants with internet gaming disorder or tobacco use disorder: Insights from normative modeling

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) used to estimate normative models of cortical thickness (CT).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Gaussian process regression was employed to generate normative models of CT development.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness (CT) derived from T1-weighted structural MRI using surface-based morphometry.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Surface-based brain morphometry (SBM) was used to calculate CT from T1weighted magnetic resonance imaging data of 804 male participants

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Normative model predicted CT using age and Euler index as covariates.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: The Predictive Clinical Neuroscience toolkit (PCNtoolkit) (https://github.com/predictive-clinical-neuroscience/PCNtool kit-demo.git) was used to estimate a normative model of CT and predict the entire brain based on participants ' age and euler index as covariates.
